macros.token: ## Experimental design: 'Fraction_Group' is the first column header of experimental_design.tsv #set $pattern = "Fraction_Group" #set $prefix = "" #set $suffix = "" @LN_FILES@ ## mzTab identification results #set $pattern = "mzTab" #set file_paths = [] #if str($software_cond.mztab) != "None": #set $at_least_one_input=True #for $file in $software_cond.mztab: @ESCAPE_IDENTIFIER@ #set file_path = $software_dir + '/' + $prefix + str($identifier) + $suffix @CHECK_LN_FILE@ #end for #end if ## Optional spectra files #set $pattern = "" #set file_paths = [] #if str($software_cond.mzml) != "None": #for $file in $software_cond.mzml: @ESCAPE_IDENTIFIER@ #set file_path = $software_dir + '/' + $prefix + str($identifier) + $suffix @CHECK_LN_FILE@ #end for #end if ## Optional idXML identification files #if str($software_cond.idxml) != "None": #for $file in $software_cond.idxml: @ESCAPE_IDENTIFIER@ #set file_path = $software_dir + '/' + $prefix + str($identifier) + $suffix @CHECK_LN_FILE@ #end for #end if

param.name: input
param.label: Experimental design file(s)
param.help: The 'experimental_design.tsv' file generated by the quantms pipeline

param.name: mztab
param.label: Identification results (mzTab)
param.help: mzTab file with the identification results, e.g. 'out.mzTab'

param.name: mzml
param.label: Spectra files (mzML)
param.help: Optional mzML files, used for spectra-level quality metrics

param.name: idxml
param.label: Identification files (idXML)
param.help: Optional idXML files from the OpenMS searches
